title: NHANES 2015-2018, clinic systolic blood pressure

population.description: Civilian, non-institutionalised US residents aged 18 and over examined in the mobile examination centre, two survey cycles combined (2015-2016 and 2017-2018).
population.exclusions: None for antihypertensive medication, cardiovascular conditions, pregnancy, or arrhythmias. Adults examined without valid blood pressure determinations are left out.

measurement.method: Auscultatory systolic blood pressure (first Korotkoff sound) measured using a mercury sphygmomanometer by a certified physician examiner.
measurement.device: Baumanometer mercury sphygmomanometer with calibrated adult/large cuff sizes.
measurement.protocol: Seated quietly for 5 minutes in a private exam room; standard CDC protocol averages readings 2 and 3 (the initial reading is discarded to mitigate acute situational anxiety).

analysis: Estimates use the examination sampling weights (WTMEC2YR), halved for the two combined cycles.
Percentiles are calculated from the survey-weighted empirical distribution.
95% confidence intervals are derived from 500 Rao-Wu bootstrap resamples of primary sampling units within strata.
Subgroups with fewer than 50 examined individuals are suppressed.
use_for: Sizing clinical trials evaluating non-invasive blood pressure monitoring devices against auscultatory mercury reference standards.
Establishing empirical population distributions and between-subject standard deviations (sigma_b) for clinic systolic blood pressure.
do_not_use_for: A direct reference for 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring (ABPM) or continuous nocturnal wearable estimates: daytime clinic auscultations exhibit higher white-coat alerting bias.
A filtered 'normotensive' reference cohort: general population participants were not excluded for hypertension or antihypertensive pharmacology.
caveats: **Clinic auscultation, not wearable PTT.** Continuous optical pulse transit time (PTT) and cuffless optical sensors measure different arterial dynamics.
**General population reference.** Participants taking ACE inhibitors, beta-blockers, or calcium channel blockers are included.
**Age 80 and over is top-coded** at 80 years in accordance with NCHS participant disclosure rules.

citation.text: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, National Center for Health Statistics. National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey Data, 2015-2018. Hyattsville, MD: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services.
citation.license: NCHS public-use data file. Users must use data for statistical reporting and analysis only.

verification: The overall survey-weighted systolic mean of 122.8 mmHg aligns with published CDC National Health Statistics Reports for the 2015-2018 cycle.
